meta.title: Phantom Pain (Part I)
meta.description: Faced with fresh tragedy, the old wounds begin to dully ache.

units.rawText:

spans.text:
> No. of Memory Data Document: CYCLOPS3112 
> Data Source: Doll, Simo, ...

units.rawText: Reporting in, Simo here. I've arrived at the Control Compartment. Everything's smooth so far.
units.displayText: Reporting in, Simo here. I've arrived at the Control Compartment. Everything's smooth so far.

spans.text: Reporting in, Simo here. I've arrived at the Control Compartment. Everything's smooth so far.

units.rawText: Copy that.
units.displayText: Copy that.

spans.text: Copy that.

units.rawText: Simo, I can't see your position.
units.displayText: Simo, I can't see your position.

spans.text: Simo, I can't see your position.

units.rawText: Is that so? Good.
units.displayText: Is that so? Good.

spans.text: Is that so? Good.

units.rawText: To prevent detection, I've done a little bit of concealing. Looks like it's working as intended..
units.displayText: To prevent detection, I've done a little bit of concealing. Looks like it's working as intended..

spans.text: To prevent detection, I've done a little bit of concealing. Looks like it's working as intended..

units.rawText: I can't believe I was fooled by technology like this...
units.displayText: I can't believe I was fooled by technology like this...

spans.text: I can't believe I was fooled by technology like this...

units.rawText: After all, we found that a Greater Sanctifier was garrisoned in this sector. I'm not sure I can handle her if she manages to track me down.
units.displayText: After all, we found that a Greater Sanctifier was garrisoned in this sector. I'm not sure I can handle her if she manages to track me down.

spans.text: After all, we found that a Greater Sanctifier was garrisoned in this sector. I'm not sure I can handle her if she manages to track me down.

units.rawText: Don't take it to heart, Croque. This is one of my core functions.
units.displayText: Don't take it to heart, Croque. This is one of my core functions.

spans.text: Don't take it to heart, Croque. This is one of my core functions.

units.rawText: How can I not? If we can't see our own people on radar, the chance of an accident raises tenfold!
units.displayText: How can I not? If we can't see our own people on radar, the chance of an accident raises tenfold!

spans.text: How can I not? If we can't see our own people on radar, the chance of an accident raises tenfold!

units.rawText: There's also the minor issue of possibly of running into that Greater Sanctifier head on...
units.displayText: There's also the minor issue of possibly of running into that Greater Sanctifier head on...

spans.text: There's also the minor issue of possibly of running into that Greater Sanctifier head on...

units.rawText: I do agree that's a problem, but rest assured. I will do everything in my power to avoid her unless an encounter is absolutely inevitable.
units.displayText: I do agree that's a problem, but rest assured. I will do everything in my power to avoid her unless an encounter is absolutely inevitable.

spans.text: I do agree that's a problem, but rest assured. I will do everything in my power to avoid her unless an encounter is absolutely inevitable.

units.rawText: Alright, alright. You haven't tripped any Sanctifiers or patrolling agents, have you?
units.displayText: Alright, alright. You haven't tripped any Sanctifiers or patrolling agents, have you?

spans.text: Alright, alright. You haven't tripped any Sanctifiers or patrolling agents, have you?

units.rawText: Not yet. They don't have any targeted countermeasures against optical camouflage.
units.displayText: Not yet. They don't have any targeted countermeasures against optical camouflage.

spans.text: Not yet. They don't have any targeted countermeasures against optical camouflage.

units.rawText: For a military-industrial sector like this, there aren't even precautions against optical camouflage? Unbelievable.
units.displayText: For a military-industrial sector like this, there aren't even precautions against optical camouflage? Unbelievable.

spans.text: For a military-industrial sector like this, there aren't even precautions against optical camouflage? Unbelievable.

units.rawText: Haha... the technology for optical camouflage isn't really commonplace yet.
units.displayText: Haha... the technology for optical camouflage isn't really commonplace yet.

spans.text: Haha... the technology for optical camouflage isn't really commonplace yet.

units.rawText: Many faculties I have equipped are currently are still in the experimental phase. I'm not sure if this'll all work so well next time.
units.displayText: Many faculties I have equipped are currently are still in the experimental phase. I'm not sure if this'll all work so well next time.

spans.text: Many faculties I have equipped are currently are still in the experimental phase. I'm not sure if this'll all work so well next time.

units.rawText: If even the Cyclopes Sector lacks countermeasures, I might as well rig up Aegis some of this camouflage for next time.
units.displayText: If even the Cyclopes Sector lacks countermeasures, I might as well rig up Aegis some of this camouflage for next time.

spans.text: If even the Cyclopes Sector lacks countermeasures, I might as well rig up Aegis some of this camouflage for next time.

units.rawText: The camouflage can't disguise auditory signals, so Aegis's transformation racket is going to give you away.
units.displayText: The camouflage can't disguise auditory signals, so Aegis's transformation racket is going to give you away.

spans.text: The camouflage can't disguise auditory signals, so Aegis's transformation racket is going to give you away.

units.rawText: So long as I can develop a recognition interference device, Aegis will be able to apply this technology. And then...
units.displayText: So long as I can develop a recognition interference device, Aegis will be able to apply this technology. And then...

spans.text: So long as I can develop a recognition interference device, Aegis will be able to apply this technology. And then...

units.rawText: ...Sigh.
units.displayText: ...Sigh.

spans.text: ...Sigh.

units.rawText: Croque, I'm only here to scout, right?
units.displayText: Croque, I'm only here to scout, right?

spans.text: Croque, I'm only here to scout, right?

units.rawText: Correct. Stay hidden, get some hard intel on Cyclopes' current situation, and return safely.
units.displayText: Correct. Stay hidden, get some hard intel on Cyclopes' current situation, and return safely.

spans.text: Correct. Stay hidden, get some hard intel on Cyclopes' current situation, and return safely.

units.rawText: But that research is so irresistible, man...
units.displayText: But that research is so irresistible, man...

spans.text: But that research is so irresistible, man...

units.rawText: Well that's that! I'll contact you again once the time comes. Bye-bye!
units.displayText: Well that's that! I'll contact you again once the time comes. Bye-bye!

spans.text: Well that's that! I'll contact you again once the time comes. Bye-bye!

units.rawText: Roger that. Over and out.
units.displayText: Roger that. Over and out.

spans.text: Roger that. Over and out.

units.rawText: The volume of data in Cyclopes is gigantic. I'll need to find some sort of map first.
units.displayText: The volume of data in Cyclopes is gigantic. I'll need to find some sort of map first.

spans.text: The volume of data in Cyclopes is gigantic. I'll need to find some sort of map first.

units.rawText: Go forward from here...
units.displayText: Go forward from here...

spans.text: Go forward from here...

units.rawText: Before Simo continues forward, he stops in his tracks.
units.displayText: Before Simo continues forward, he stops in his tracks.

spans.text: Before Simo continues forward, he stops in his tracks.

units.rawText: Requesting transfer of document: 279b79227b35941cf4b3.
units.displayText: Requesting transfer of document: 279b79227b35941cf4b3.

spans.text: Requesting transfer of document: 279b79227b35941cf4b3.

units.rawText: Orientation complete... Category: Original Prototype Data.
units.displayText: Orientation complete... Category: Original Prototype Data.

spans.text: Orientation complete... Category: Original Prototype Data.

units.rawText: Document Notes: Gaul-1
units.displayText: Document Notes: Gaul-1

spans.text: Document Notes: Gaul-1

units.rawText: This document contains data regarding original prototypes that cannot be circulated. Please move to terminal B-01 to view the document.
units.displayText: This document contains data regarding original prototypes that cannot be circulated. Please move to terminal B-01 to view the document.

spans.text: This document contains data regarding original prototypes that cannot be circulated. Please move to terminal B-01 to view the document.

units.rawText: (Gaul-1... A document about me?)
units.displayText: Gaul-1... A document about me?

spans.text: Gaul-1... A document about me?

units.rawText: (What is something about me doing in Cyclopes? I have to get to the bottom of this...)
units.displayText: What is something about me doing in Cyclopes? I have to get to the bottom of this...

spans.text: What is something about me doing in Cyclopes? I have to get to the bottom of this...

units.rawText: Received. Moving to Terminal B-01.
units.displayText: Received. Moving to Terminal B-01.

spans.text: Received. Moving to Terminal B-01.

units.rawText: The agent who requested document transfer took their leave. Only one agent remained, still arranging documents.
units.displayText: The agent who requested document transfer took their leave. Only one agent remained, still arranging documents.

spans.text: The agent who requested document transfer took their leave. Only one agent remained, still arranging documents.

units.rawText: Simo approaches like a ghost, pressing his crossbow's business end against the back of her head.
units.displayText: Simo approaches like a ghost, pressing his crossbow's business end against the back of her head.

spans.text: Simo approaches like a ghost, pressing his crossbow's business end against the back of her head.

units.rawText: Huh! No abnormal agent has been detected...who are you?
units.displayText: Huh! No abnormal agent has been detected...who are you?

spans.text: Huh! No abnormal agent has been detected...who are you?

units.rawText: Don't turn around.
units.displayText: Don't turn around.

spans.text: Don't turn around.

units.rawText: I have no intention of resetting you, so long as you fetch Document 279b79227b35941cf4b3 for me.
units.displayText: I have no intention of resetting you, so long as you fetch Document 279b79227b35941cf4b3 for me.

spans.text: I have no intention of resetting you, so long as you fetch Document 279b79227b35941cf4b3 for me.

units.rawText: ...I must know your identity before executing such a command. Who are you?
units.displayText: ...I must know your identity before executing such a command. Who are you?

spans.text: ...I must know your identity before executing such a command. Who are you?

units.rawText: That is irrelevant. You have the permissions. Simply do as I say.
units.displayText: That is irrelevant. You have the permissions. Simply do as I say.

spans.text: That is irrelevant. You have the permissions. Simply do as I say.

units.rawText: This is no negotiation. This is an order.
units.displayText: This is no negotiation. This is an order.

spans.text: This is no negotiation. This is an order.

units.rawText: The data about original prototypes are classified as top secret. I cannot display them to unidentified Agents.
units.displayText: The data about original prototypes are classified as top secret. I cannot display them to unidentified Agents.

spans.text: The data about original prototypes are classified as top secret. I cannot display them to unidentified Agents.

units.rawText: Besides, I only take orders from Olivia. No other individual can command me.
units.displayText: Besides, I only take orders from Olivia. No other individual can command me.

spans.text: Besides, I only take orders from Olivia. No other individual can command me.

units.rawText: ...That agent who just left also has the necessary permissions. If you won't do it, I'll go for her instead.
units.displayText: ...That agent who just left also has the necessary permissions. If you won't do it, I'll go for her instead.

spans.text: ...That agent who just left also has the necessary permissions. If you won't do it, I'll go for her instead.

units.rawText: Before Simo's sentence was finished, the agent reached for a button on the control panel.
units.displayText: Before Simo's sentence was finished, the agent reached for a button on the control panel.

spans.text: Before Simo's sentence was finished, the agent reached for a button on the control panel.

units.rawText: Simo hesitates for a split second. Instead of firing his weapon, he lunges for her arm, intercepting her wrist halfway.
units.displayText: Simo hesitates for a split second. Instead of firing his weapon, he lunges for her arm, intercepting her wrist halfway.

spans.text: Simo hesitates for a split second. Instead of firing his weapon, he lunges for her arm, intercepting her wrist halfway.

units.rawText: Monitor 104, this is a trustworthy individual.
units.displayText: Monitor 104, this is a trustworthy individual.

spans.text: Monitor 104, this is a trustworthy individual.

units.rawText: Clear alerts. Retrieving Document 279b79227b35941cf4b3.
units.displayText: Clear alerts. Retrieving Document 279b79227b35941cf4b3.

spans.text: Clear alerts. Retrieving Document 279b79227b35941cf4b3.

units.rawText: (When did this person appear...?)
units.displayText: When did this person appear...?

spans.text: When did this person appear...?

units.rawText: Command accepted.
units.displayText: Command accepted.

spans.text: Command accepted.

units.rawText: The agent named Monitor 104 struggles to free herself from Simo's clutch before retrieving the relevant document.
units.displayText: The agent named Monitor 104 struggles to free herself from Simo's clutch before retrieving the relevant document.

spans.text: The agent named Monitor 104 struggles to free herself from Simo's clutch before retrieving the relevant document.

units.rawText: That's enough. You can go and get some rest.
units.displayText: That's enough. You can go and get some rest.

spans.text: That's enough. You can go and get some rest.

units.rawText: Don't look back. Leave from the side door.
units.displayText: Don't look back. Leave from the side door.

spans.text: Don't look back. Leave from the side door.

units.rawText: Olivia, just who is he?
units.displayText: Olivia, just who is he?

spans.text: Olivia, just who is he?

units.rawText: Don't worry. He's our friend. Nothing bad will happen.
units.displayText: Don't worry. He's our friend. Nothing bad will happen.

spans.text: Don't worry. He's our friend. Nothing bad will happen.

units.rawText: Monitor 104 leaves.
units.displayText: Monitor 104 leaves.

spans.text: Monitor 104 leaves.

units.rawText: Simo turns around and looks at the female agent standing at the door.
units.displayText: Simo turns around and looks at the female agent standing at the door.

spans.text: Simo turns around and looks at the female agent standing at the door.

units.rawText: And you are?
units.displayText: And you are?

spans.text: And you are?

units.rawText: It is the first time for you, but for us... Long time no see, Gaul, or should I say, "Simo."
units.displayText: It is the first time for you, but for us... Long time no see, Gaul, or should I say, "Simo."

spans.text: It is the first time for you, but for us... Long time no see, Gaul, or should I say, "Simo."

units.rawText: ...Answer my question.
units.displayText: ...Answer my question.

spans.text: ...Answer my question.

units.rawText: I'm Olivia, an administrator of the Cyclopes Sector.
units.displayText: I'm Olivia, an administrator of the Cyclopes Sector.

spans.text: I'm Olivia, an administrator of the Cyclopes Sector.

units.rawText: Let's cut to the chase. What are you looking for? Perhaps we can work together...
units.displayText: Let's cut to the chase. What are you looking for? Perhaps we can work together...

spans.text: Let's cut to the chase. What are you looking for? Perhaps we can work together...
